name: @geo-content-os/eval-geo-optimizer
description: Versioned offline evaluation for the geo-optimizer Skill

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/contracts build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/skills build && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --pretty false
scripts.eval: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/skills test -- geo-optimizer && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && node dist/cli.js --manifest fixtures/geo-optimizer-eval.v1.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/contracts build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/skills build && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
